text:
Raj P: FYI got the vendor manifest but depot is asking for preflight depot-acceptance + serial audit before they release the POD to carrier.
Sasha G: link to manifest: https://files.redwood.internal/manifests/849201 (redacted) — includes 20x A100-80GB, 2 pallets.
Tay: who put the invoice on hold? Finance flagged AWB 849201 with 'pending audit' tag.
Raj P: that AWB is the Mon morning SFO dock slot (ETA Mon 06:00). Vendor originally committed Mon 02:00 but customs might push.
Hannah: vendor just offered weekend depot acceptance (they'll staff Saturday) but +$500/pallet. Can we approve?
Maya: finance — we can greenlight up to $3k one-off for urgent swaps, need PO amendment and cost center.
Tay: vendor also reported 3 serial mismatches: H100-4832, H100-4833, H100-4834. They want RMA pre-approval to swap before shipping.
Raj P: do we have buffer capacity if those are swapped out? Dedicated pool usage for next week is ~85% in us-west1.
Sasha G: ops runbook says hold if >80% unless it's hot. This is borderline. Could route part to us-central staging to decompress.
Tay: vendor prefers single AWB; splitting adds customs reclearance and fee.
Raj P: ask vendor whether split AWB is possible and the exact fee. Also check if depot can accept 1 pallet this weekend and hold the other until Monday.
VendorBot: vendor system update — split AWB available; extra fee $220 and will require customs reclearance for split portion.
VendorRep: we can staff Saturday for depot acceptance on 1 pallet, mark 3 flagged serials for pre-swap, and split AWB if you request. ETA still Mon 06:00 unless customs clears earlier.
Hannah: timeline — we need yes/no within 3 hours to keep the Monday dock slot.
Raj P: decision path: (1) Approve weekend acceptance for 1 pallet ($500) to secure partial intake, (2) Approve split AWB option if depot requests, (3) Pre-approve RMA swap for the 3 serials so vendor can replace before ship.
Sasha G: I'll update the PO for the Saturday acceptance charge and add the split-AWB contingency. Pinged procurement: @Maya.
Maya: got the ping — updating PO now, will attach amendment to this thread when done.
Tay: I'll open an RMA pre-approval ticket and include the serials. Quick snippet to include in ticket:
```
Serials needing pre-swap:
- H100-4832
- H100-4833
- H100-4834
Shipment AWB: 849201
Depot: SFO-MAIN-DEPOT
```
Raj P: perfect. Also, logistics question: if we split AWB and route part to us-central, how long is customs reclearance?
VendorRep: reclearance typically 24–48h depending on port. If you split now, expect +36h average.
Sasha G: tradeoff = extra fee +36h vs. weekend acceptance +$500 and keep single AWB.
Hannah: recommend weekend accept 1 pallet to relieve critical nodes, approve pre-swap, and keep split AWB as fallback.
Raj P: agreed. Sasha — confirm PO amendment and reply to vendor. Tay — create RMA ticket and attach serial list. Hannah — monitor customs. VendorRep — proceed with weekend staffing and mark for pre-swap; we will confirm AWB split only if depot requests.
Sasha G: confirmed, sending PO amendment now and notifying vendor. :thumbsup:
VendorRep: acknowledged, weekend team provisioned; will mark flagged serials and hold pallet until PO amendment shows on manifest.
Tay: RMA ticket created #RMA-3921, assigned to Tay, will link back here.
LogisticsBot: ticket created: RMA-3921 | pre-swap approval | AWB 849201 | assignee Tay.
Raj P: thanks all — follow ups tracked. We'll reopen if customs fires or vendor changes ETA.
